ev.q: From 2001 to 2010, the percentage of emergency department visits with a CT or MRI test ordered or provided nearly tripled
the percentage of visits with an ultrasound ordered or provided doubled from 2% to 4%
the percentage of visits with a radiograph was higher than the percentage with a CT/MRI or ultrasound combined
Source: CDC. National Hospital Ambulatory Medical Care Survey.
